title: The Red Road to Crimson Dunes
summary: A basic Player Mode preview route where Waru cautiously observes a mixed outsider group connected to the emerging Crimson Dunes School.
visibilityRule: Only Waru-visible or player-approved context should be shown in Player Mode.

nodes.title: Red Dust Approach
nodes.purpose: Opening threshold; establish heat, distance, signs of travel, and Waru’s observation-first position.
nodes.sceneText: Heat shimmers over the red road. Waru keeps distance from the travelling outsiders and reads the country before acting.
consequencesPreview: indirectly_intervene: alter route without revealing self
reveal_self: shift encounter into direct contact

nodes.title: Dry Creek Sign
nodes.purpose: First environmental/magical sign that outsiders may misread.
nodes.sceneText: A dry creek line cuts across the route. Small signs suggest the outsiders may misread the place and the safest path through it.
consequencesPreview: indirectly_intervene: alter route without revealing self
reveal_self: shift encounter into direct contact

nodes.title: Distant Smoke / Hidden Track
nodes.purpose: First decision pressure: continue observing, interpret, withdraw, indirectly intervene, or reveal.
nodes.sceneText: Smoke rises at a distance near a hidden track. Continuing unseen may preserve safety, but inaction may allow a mistake to grow.
consequencesPreview: indirectly_intervene: alter route without revealing self
reveal_self: shift encounter into direct contact

currentObjective: Observe the route toward Crimson Dunes without revealing more than necessary.

observe.result: Waru stays hidden and gains more context from the route.
observe.discoveredFact: The outsiders are not reading the country carefully.

interpret.result: Waru compares signs, track, and subtle magical pressure before acting.
interpret.discoveredFact: The dry creek line may be a safer boundary than a path.

withdraw.result: Waru creates distance and avoids forcing direct contact.
withdraw.discoveredFact: Withdrawal preserves secrecy but loses immediate influence.

indirectly_intervene.result: Waru alters the situation without revealing identity.
indirectly_intervene.discoveredFact: Indirect action can protect without breaking observation-first rules.

reveal_self.result: Waru risks direct contact and shifts the route into a different style of encounter.
reveal_self.discoveredFact: Revealing identity should become a major route state change.
